candidates.buyer: Dormant or low-activity Andorran companies and the gestories and fiduciaries who hold them (about 4,000 without BO declaration; about 2,500 presumed inactive)
candidates.existing: Competitor search (Catalan) found no software or named service for this. Only the law texts and press. Gestories offer it as advisory work, not product.
candidates.known_note: Same gestoria buyer group as K01, but a different duty (BO declaration and dissolution defence versus PGC accounts deposit).
candidates.name: C1 Regularisation pack for inactive companies (accounts deposit, BO declaration, tax catch-up) under the inactive-company dissolution law
candidates.trigger: Llei 17/2026 of 14 July (CCIS PDF title; BOPA text unconfirmed): administrative dissolution without liquidation. A short voluntary regularisation window (1 month in the draft; Concòrdia proposed 5). Fines EUR 500-2,000 and EUR 2,500-15,000. Moneyval and OECD Global Forum pressure.
candidates.unchecked: Final enacted text and dates (BOPA); size of paying demand; one-off window, so little recurring revenue; whether Govern offers a free portal for BO declaration; real number of companies that care.

candidates.buyer: Private landlords and small real-estate agencies / property administrators holding rental contracts (about 20,000 contracts leaving forced extension 2027-2030)
candidates.existing: Competitor search (Catalan) found no Andorran lease-management software. Only the Pisos.ad listing portal (not a management tool).
candidates.known_note: Landlords of residential leases are a different buyer group and duty from K02 (tourist rentals).
candidates.name: C2 Landlord and agency lease tracker for rent deregulation (exit dates, rent increases, notices)
candidates.trigger: Law of progressive rent deregulation passed by the Consell General on 3 June 2026; Llei 24/2023 base. Staggered exit by signature year and rent per m2. CPI-linked increases. Exact rules unverified.
candidates.unchecked: Text of the law as published and what notices or filings it requires; whether it is a real compliance duty or simply a date calculator; landlord willingness to pay; political risk of reversal.

candidates.buyer: Households employing domestic staff, and gestories serving them
candidates.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
candidates.existing: The CASS portal itself (free, with certificate) and delegated access to a gestoria through a CASS form. No dedicated household product found.
candidates.name: C3 Household-employer CASS monthly declaration and payroll service
candidates.trigger: CASS rule: register within 7 days before start, deregister within 3 days after last day, monthly declaration and payment on days 1-15 with a digital certificate (22% employer, 6.5% withheld); surcharges under art. 93 Llei 17/2008.
candidates.unchecked: Number of household employers; whether a gestoria already does this for a small fee; labour-law minimums for domestic work.

candidates.existing: None found. The state register probably takes the filing directly.
candidates.known_note: Same BO and AML-transparency theme as K05 but a different buyer (associations, not obliged entities); K05 was rejected for few buyers.
candidates.name: C4 Associations and foundations beneficial-owner and register compliance
candidates.trigger: New associations register regulation approved by the Council of Ministers in July 2026 (replacing 2001 rules); BO and institutional email registration; foundations register reform in Aug 2026 shortens deadlines.
candidates.unchecked: Number of associations; deadline and penalties; whether the filing is a simple online form.

candidates.buyer: Taxi licence holders and VTC operators (about 120-130 taxis and 100-110 VTCs under the cap)
candidates.existing: The state-mandated Taxi Andorra app and dispatch centre cover booking. No compliance tool found.
candidates.name: C5 Taxi and VTC fleet and driver compliance
candidates.trigger: April 2026 package: fleet caps, two vehicles per licence on rotating drivers within driving-time limits, mandatory single dispatch centre, new professional-driver credential (VTC drivers have 6 months).
candidates.unchecked: BOPA text of the regulation; whether driving-time logs are required of owners; very few buyers.

candidates.buyer: Andorran fuel importers, distributors and stations (association Asidca)
candidates.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
candidates.name: C6 Fuel station and distributor tax-discount refund reporting (July 2026)
candidates.trigger: Temporary law on hydrocarbon prices applying to sales from 15 July 2026: special hydrocarbons tax suspended, extra discount by stations, Finance Ministry refunds to distributors.
candidates.unchecked: Law text (Consell General document returned 503); declaration and refund procedure; end date. Likely temporary with a handful of buyers.

candidates.buyer: Small hotels, guest houses and refuges (non-HUT)
candidates.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals
candidates.existing: Hotel property-management systems are likely to cover it. Not checked.
candidates.name: C7 ROAT guest-register submission for hotels, guest houses and mountain refuges
candidates.trigger: Amendments to the 1998 general tourist accommodation law created the Registre d'Ocupació d'Allotjaments Turístics. Serious offence if not updated; guests refusing ID reported to police. Implementing decree planned but status unconfirmed.
candidates.unchecked: Whether the ROAT decree is in force; whether the state offers a free portal or API; PMS coverage.

candidates.trigger: Proposició de llei of a national mandatory electronic Property Register, unanimously admitted June 2026; rolling inscription over 8-10 years, full operation targeted 2027-2028. Still a bill.
candidates.unchecked: Final law and dates; whether the register brings recurring duties for small firms.

candidates.trigger: Reglament del Padral (BOPA 15, 7/2/2001), sheep and goat identification regulation (BOPA 67, 1/12/2010), Registre d'Explotacions Agràries, Llei 14/2012.
candidates.unchecked: Number of farms (very small); current versions of the regulations; whether the Government already provides an online tool.

candidates.trigger: Llei 25/2004 on waste and the 2005 Reglament de gestors privats: register, bond, insurance, inspections; Govern list of health-waste transporters.
candidates.unchecked: Number of gestors; reporting frequency; current regulation text.

coverage.category: 1. Household employers: domestic workers, live-in carers, nannies
coverage.found: CASS fitxa (Feb and Jul 2026): the household owner must register the worker within 7 days before start and deregister within 3 days after the last day worked. Each month they declare gross pay and hours (with in-kind items) and pay 22% employer plus 6.5% withheld, from the 1st to the 15th of the following month, using a digital certificate. Late payment carries surcharges under art. 93 Llei 17/2008. A gestoria can be given delegated access through a CASS form. The CASS portal is free. Candidate C3.

coverage.category: 2. Scrap-metal dealers
coverage.found: No Andorran scrap register found beyond the private waste-manager register (Reglament de gestors privats de residus, 2005). Nothing new.

coverage.category: 3. Second-hand dealers and pawnbrokers
coverage.found: No Andorran second-hand or precious-metal dealer register found. Only Llei 11/2013 (a tax rule on used goods under IGI) came up. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 4. Gold and jewellery buyers
coverage.found: No Andorran precious-metals record-keeping rule found. Results were Spanish regional rules (Catalonia, Basque Country), which do not apply here. AML duties for such dealers sit under Llei 14/2017 and Decret 46/2025, which is K05. Unverified whether any police register exists.

coverage.category: 5. Used car parts and vehicle dismantlers
coverage.found: No Andorran end-of-life-vehicle or dismantler regime found. Private waste managers fall under the 2005 reglament. Few buyers. Nothing new.

coverage.category: 6. Livestock traders, markets and animal transport
coverage.found: Govern lists the Padral regulation (BOPA 15, 7/2/2001) on livestock holding, the Registre d'Explotacions Agràries, and the sheep and goat identification regulation (BOPA 67, 1/12/2010). Llei 14/2012 on animal health. Very small farmer base. Candidate C9 (unverified).

coverage.category: 7. Small abattoirs and butchers
coverage.found: Llei 14/2012 on animal health and food safety sets the competent veterinary authority. No specific small-abattoir or butcher register found. Nothing found.

coverage.category: 8. Beekeepers
coverage.found: No Andorran apiculture register found in the one search. Unverified and likely trivial in size.

coverage.category: 9. Veterinary practices and veterinary medicine sellers
coverage.found: Only the Llei 14/2012 framework and the Govern animal-health regulations list were found. No veterinary medicine register or reporting rule found. Unverified.

coverage.category: 10. Well drillers and water abstraction
coverage.found: Budget used on higher-yield categories; no search run.

coverage.category: 11. Septic, sanitation and waste haulers
coverage.found: Llei 25/2004 on waste and its 2005 Reglament de gestors privats de residus create the Registre de Gestors Privats (insurance, bond, inspections). The Govern publishes lists of gestors authorised to transport health waste. Few operators. Candidate C10 (weak).

coverage.category: 12. Lift, boiler and pressure-equipment owners and inspectors
coverage.found: The search returned only Spanish material. No Andorran lift or boiler inspection regime was confirmed. Unverified.

coverage.category: 13. Small water systems
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 14. Pesticide and fertiliser dealers and applicators
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 15. Labour contractors and recruitment agencies
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 16. Cemeteries, burial societies and funeral services
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 17. Community and religious bodies: associations, charities, halal and kosher supervision
coverage.found: Council of Ministers approved a new associations register regulation in July 2026 (replacing the 2001 rules). Associations must record their beneficial owners and an institutional email. No deadline or penalty stated in the article. A foundations register reform was also reported in August 2026. Candidate C4.

coverage.category: 18. Transport operators: minibus, taxi, moto-taxi, small trucking and bus fleets
coverage.found: April 2026 taxi and VTC package: fleet caps (about 120-130 taxis, 100-110 VTCs), mandatory single dispatch centre and Taxi Andorra app, and a new professional-driver credential. In Sept 2026 the Government was pressing holdouts to join. The 1993 transport law has the Registre General de Transportistes. The state dictates the app. Candidate C5.

coverage.category: 19. Market traders, street vendors, money changers
coverage.found: Andorra has no meaningful street-vendor or money-changer sector. Commerce is licensed under Llei 12/2013, with about 14,051 active businesses in 2025.

coverage.category: 20. Small licensed premises with inspections: tattoo studios, driving schools, childminders and nurseries, small food producers, hunting outfitters
coverage.found: Budget; no search run. Nursery, driving school and food-producer rules remain unchecked.

coverage.category: 21. Fuel stations and fuel or LPG distributors
coverage.found: Temporary law on hydrocarbon prices, presented 10 July 2026 and applied to sales from 15 July 2026. It suspends the special hydrocarbons tax, with an extra discount given by the stations. Alto.ad says the Finance Ministry is working on distributor refunds. Importers are grouped in Asidca. The text and the law number could not be fetched (seu.consellgeneral.ad returned 503). Few operators and a temporary measure. Candidate C6 (unverified).

coverage.category: 22. Grain, coffee, cocoa and other commodity traders, millers and warehouses
coverage.found: Andorra is a landlocked microstate with no commodity trading, milling or warehousing sector of note.

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: CASS publishes annual conveni lists (generalists, labs). Dietitians are joining CASS in September 2026 with a decree on funding from 1 September. Electronic prescription is promised before 2027 using an in-house government module (pilot announced April 2026). Billing runs through CASS forms and the state system. Nothing new beyond a state-built system.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: One search found nothing on Andorran narcotics registers. The state e-prescription project (see category 24) is the only item. Unverified.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Budget; no search run.

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: AML duties under Llei 14/2017 and Decret 46/2025 are K05 (rejected). The national Property Register bill was unanimously admitted in June 2026 (electronic, mandatory, rolling in over 8-10 years, full operation targeted 2027-2028). It is still a bill. Candidate C8 (unverified).

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: ROAT guest-data register was created by amendments to the 1998 tourist accommodation law. The implementing decree was listed as planned in a late-2022 Government table and was not confirmed adopted. Llei 5/2025 (6 March) on sustainable growth and housing is in force. A March 2026 government text cancels HUT registrations after 12 idle months. There were 107 EGHUT with 2,358 units in 2025. HUT is covered by K02. Candidate C7 (hotels and refuges ROAT, unverified).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: Andorra is a landlocked microstate with no relevant export-traceability sector. The EC-Andorra veterinary protocol covers import rules, which are handled by the state.

coverage.category: 31. Administrative dissolution of inactive companies (Llei 17/2026 of 14 July)
coverage.found: Govern presentation (4 May 2026): about 15,000 companies on the register, about 4,000 without a beneficial-owner declaration, about 2,500 presumed inactive. Triggers are repeated failure to deposit accounts, tax defaults, or no BO declaration. The process takes at most 6 months, with a one-month voluntary regularisation window (Concòrdia sought 5 months). Fines are EUR 500-2,000 for late accounts and EUR 2,500-15,000 for transparency failures, with a 25% early-payment discount. A CCIS PDF carries the title Llei 17/2026 del 14 de juliol, but the BOPA text was not confirmed. Candidate C1.

coverage.category: 32. Rent deregulation law (June 2026): landlord and agency duties
coverage.found: Consell General passed the progressive rent deregulation law on 3 June 2026. About 20,000 of roughly 25,000 contracts are in forced extension, leaving it gradually between 2027 and 2030 (2012 or older, or rent of EUR 6/m2 or less, go first). Annual increases are tied to CPI plus a margin. Final percentages are unverified. Llei 24/2023 is the earlier base. Candidate C2.

coverage.category: 33. Associations and foundations register reforms (2026)
coverage.found: See category 17. Beneficial-owner registration is extended to associations. The foundations reform shortens filing deadlines (alto.ad, Aug 2026). Candidate C4.

coverage.category: 34. Taxi/VTC reform and professional-driver credential (2026)
coverage.found: See category 18. Candidate C5.

coverage.category: 35. Audit law implementation (Llei 30/2025 and Decret 223/2026 of 10 June 2026) and new PGC (2026)
coverage.found: Decret 223/2026 sets registration and data updates for the audit register. A 2026 PGC decree is published by CCIS (the K01 area). Auditors are few. Candidate C11 (weak).

coverage.category: 36. Temporary hydrocarbon-price measures (July 2026)
coverage.found: See category 21. Candidate C6.

coverage.category: 37. Invoicing obligations (Decret 296/2024) and CASS company registration (Decret 135/2024)
coverage.found: Decret 296/2024 (24 July 2024) regulates invoicing obligations, which is K04/K06 (e-invoicing, rejected). Decret 135/2024 covers CASS company registration, affiliation and data changes, and Decret 124/2024 covers contributions. These are state portals, so nothing new.
